resources.string: Fast, secure file transfer directly between devices
Pick one or more files with the system file picker. No storage permission is required.
Ready to connect to a nearby device.
Your device is visible now, waiting for a connection request…
Tap a device to start the connection. The other device confirms the transfer before anything is sent.
Make sure the other device is on the Receive screen with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on, and that both devices are close together.
Keep Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on and move closer to the other device. Make sure the Receive screen is open on the other device.
Your device is visible. Wait for another device to start sending, then accept the request.
Waiting for the transfer to start…
Waiting for the other device to accept the connection…
Make your device visible so another device can send files to you.
Accept the connection to start receiving files. Nothing is transferred before you confirm.
The same code should appear on both devices before you continue.
You can return to the transfer screen to follow its progress.
Files are written to a temporary file first, verified, then moved with a unique name. Partial files are never shown as complete.
All files were delivered and verified on the other device.
The transfer was canceled. No partial files were kept.
Completed transfers appear here with name, size, speed and status.
File contents are never stored in the history.
History is stored locally as a small JSON file inside the app. It contains no file contents.
Some permissions are required to start discovery.
Bluetooth is used for discovery only. Bulk data travels over local Wi-Fi.
The app needs no storage permission. Received files are written to the app-specific folder and can be moved with a file manager.
The app follows the system language. Arabic is the default and its UI is right-to-left.
Direct device-to-device transfers only. No account, no cloud, no internet, no mobile data.
Real speed depends on both devices, Wi-Fi quality, distance and the environment. Displayed numbers are measurements, not promises.
Measure real transfer speed with a test file
Pick a receiving device to measure real speed
The benchmark sends a real test file to a receiving device and measures the complete transfer. No numbers are invented.
Sending a real test file… do not close the screen on the receiving device.
The measurement could not be completed. Check the connection and try again.
This number measures a real device-to-device transfer over Nearby Connections, including the receiver writing the file to disk. Results vary with conditions.
The app needs Bluetooth and Wi-Fi permissions to find nearby devices and establish a direct connection. Data travels over local Wi-Fi, not Bluetooth or the internet.
Used on older Android versions (12 and below) to discover nearby devices through Nearby Connections.
Permission denied. Transfer features will not work until it is granted.
Nearby Connections is unavailable. Make sure Google Play Services is up to date.
Make sure Google Play Services is up to date.
Turn on Bluetooth to discover nearby devices and connect. Files travel over Wi-Fi.
Turn on Wi-Fi for high-speed transfers. Nearby Connections uses it for the data.
Connection to the other device was lost
A file with the same name already exists
APK files can be shared through the file picker and are never installed automatically.
